messages:
Ava: Quick Q2 milestone check — runtime v3 on Dedicated + Private. Who has live canary/what slipped? :wave:
Ravi: Dedicated canary is live in us-west (5% traffic). Basic gen + embeddings paths OK.
Marta: Saw a single OOM during a synthetic burst at ~2.2k req/s, working hypothesis is a batcher edge case.
Kai: Looking now. batcher seemed to under-allocate when prefix cache miss happens. I have a local patch, will open PR.
Diego: Holding Private UI feature flag off until we confirm stable rollout.
Jen: Telemetry: Dedicated P95 down ~18% vs v2. Private staging metrics not arriving — bootstrap failing on some hosts.
Jen: ```
Error: missing KMS token during bootstrap
 at bootstrap.init (/app/bootstrap.js:42)
```
Ravi: @Priya any idea on the KMS token failure? Could be the signed artifact we needed.
Priya (Security): I saw the failed attest. We need the signed deploy artifact from Eng infra. I'll escalate.
Ava: Quick summary request: what shipped, what slipped, owners for the slipped items?
Ravi: Shipped: Dedicated canary, model-cache v2, autoscale hook improvements.
Ravi: Slipped: Private VPC onboarding (telemetry + KMS), batcher CR for the under-allocation case, and the rollout runbook/docs.
Ava: Owners?
Ravi: Private VPC onboarding -> Marta + Priya.
Kai: Batcher CR -> Kai (me) + Diego for API surface.
Sam: Docs/runbook -> Sam + Ava to coordinate. I'll start a draft.
Marta: ETA on Private fix is ~48h once Sec signs the artifact. I'll queue verification tests.
Priya (Security): Aiming to clear artifact by EOD tomorrow, pending a quick compliance check.
Diego: Opening CR for the API change now — tagging reviewers @Liam and @Nita.
Liam: Reviewing now, will try to finish within the day.
okrs-bot: Auto-summary recorded: Q2 milestone check-in — runtime v3 (Dedicated canary live), actions assigned, followups due. Add retrospective notes by Friday.
Ava: Next steps (short): 1) Priya finish artifact signing; 2) Marta run verification on private staging; 3) Kai merge batcher CR; 4) Sam publish runbook. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: Small ask — can reviewers prioritize the batcher CR (1-day turnaround requested)? This blocks Private rollout.
Diego: Will add a callout in the PR and ping reviewers.
Jen: Once KMS is available I'll re-run telemetry ingest and confirm metrics pipeline.
Marta: Plan: once Sec clears, we flip a limited canary to private staging and run the burst test again.
Ava: If everyone ok with the plan I'll mark milestone status as "partial" and link owner checklist in the OKR doc. Anyone object?
Diego: :thumbsup:
Liam: :+1:
Sam: I'll have the runbook draft up in the doc by EOD. Ping me for details.
Priya (Security): Noted. Will update this thread when artifact is signed.
Ravi: Thanks all — will follow up in the PRs and update the OKR tracker.
Ava: Thanks team — keeping this thread for async updates.
